Maya R.: Heads-up — opened PR that changes the k8s module to add managed identities + updates the serviceAccount role bindings. Need a quick sanity check before merge. Main concerns: (1) GH Actions currently triggers ArgoCD auto-sync on merge, we want Atlantis apply to run first; (2) secrets wiring for new key needs to be KMS-backed and not accidentally applied by ArgoCD. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452 :eyes:

atlantis-bot: Atlantis started plan for PR #452 (workspace: default)
```
Plan: 2 to add, 1 to change, 0 to destroy.
+ module.k8s_service.redwood_identity
~ module.k8s_rbac.role_bindings
```
(See full plan at https://atlantis.redwood.ai/plans/452)

Kofi A.: Quick read — plan looks straightforward. Two suggestions to gate ArgoCD: (a) change GH Actions so ArgoCD sync job runs only if Atlantis apply reported successful (we set a repo status); (b) add a hold annotation on the ArgoCD app that we remove post-apply. Example GH Actions conditional:```yaml
- name: Trigger ArgoCD sync
  if: ${{ github.event.pull_request.merged == true && needs.atlantis_apply.outputs.status == 'success' }}
  run: curl -X POST ${{ secrets.ARGOCD_SYNC_URL }}
```
Sophia L.: For (b) we already support a repo-level convention: annotate apps with `redwood.io/hold-sync: "true"` and our argocd-sync-controller ignores apps with that annotation. So add that annotation in the kustomize overlay and have Atlantis apply step remove it (or set to "false") after apply. Example to remove annotation in a post-apply script:```bash
kubectl annotate app my-service redwood.io/hold-sync-
# removes the annotation
```
devops-bot: Note: secrets rule — use sops + KMS for repo-encrypted values. Do NOT add plaintext secrets to the kustomize overlays. If you need runtime secrets, wire them via the secrets manager and reference with ExternalSecret. See infra/decisions/secrets.md :lock_with_ink_pen:

Kofi A.: I'll open a tiny follow-up PR to change the GH Actions workflow: add a `needs: atlantis_apply` job and output a status. Then the `argocd_sync` job will be conditional on that success. Also will add a post-apply step that runs `kubectl annotate` to clear the hold. Patch snippet:```yaml
jobs:
  atlantis_apply:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      status: ${{ steps.apply.outputs.result }}
  argocd_sync:
    needs: atlantis_apply
    if: ${{ needs.atlantis_apply.outputs.status == 'success' }}
```
Maya R.: Perfect — thanks. Kofi, ping me when the workflow PR is up and I'll do a quick review. Sophia, can you add a tiny note to the kustomize overlay to include `redwood.io/hold-sync: "true"` for the app?

Sophia L.: Yep will add that to infra/apps/overlays/prod/my-service/kustomization.yaml and include a README note.

Maya R.: One more question — Atlantis plan showed a small RBAC change. Anyone worry this will break bootstrap? :thinking_face:

Kofi A.: I checked — role change is expanding a binding to include `system:serviceaccount:infra:deployer` which is expected. We already have a canary argocd app in staging that mirrors this — I ran the staging deploy last night and it was fine. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Reminder: after merge, rotate the KMS key's IAM binding review in 24h and monitor for failed syncs. I'll post an incident alert if argocd reports denied resources.

Maya R.: Great — will wait for Kofi's workflow PR. Thanks all :heart:

(Reaction :thumbsup: from Sophia L.)
